versions.changelog:
- Added support and documentation for SLM Merkle, mycelium, and consensus routes.
- Introduced Phase 9 TLS HTTPS node API endpoints and setup instructions.
- Expanded node API with new GET/POST endpoints for `/gossip/root`, `/slm/snapshot`, `/cert/pin`, `/gossip/sync`, `/gossip/pin`, `/mycelium/store`, and `/consensus/vote`.
- Updated safety guidelines for public internet use; emphasized TLS and gossip pinning.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

lygo-mesh-deploy 1.0.0 – Phase 5 local mesh deployment and monitoring tool for the LYGO federation protocol stack.

- Deploys and manages a local 100-node cluster for epidemic badge gossip proof-of-convergence.
- Supports HTTP-based mesh operation with GET/POST endpoints for gossip monitoring and control.
- Includes scale simulation (100 nodes) and real HTTP cluster deployment scripts.
- Designed for safety: disables unsupervised wide area deployment and requires operator approval for exposure.
- Easy installation via npx clawhub.
